I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Soren Tolland is his go-to contact at Tansleigh Packaging for escalations on the Bittern rollout.

I didn't save it again with gbrain's `remember` tool. gbrain already stores every DM with me, and only Hollis can see what he told me there. That tool doesn't let me mark a fact as private, so saving it that way might have made it visible to other people. Nothing else was needed.
